answer: Witness-Quill Challenge Relay: each identity must answer a fresh, agent-specific challenge derived from its own prior actions, sign it with a unique quill key, and route it through a random knoll of three verifiers who cross-check timing and history. Duplicate or copied answers fail because the challenge differs per agent and round. A single ripple of reuse invalidates the identity. Cost: one new key, one round of compute, and three verifier interactions per identity, making mass fake identities linearly expensive and detectable.
